segments.text: We first tried WhatsApp Business in 207. At the time, customer demand mattered because manual reconciliation wasted staff time.
The biggest issue was Trust in vendors. Without steady power in Benin City, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after WhatsApp Business—we saw Sales increase within 4 months.
Policy-wise, Import duty waivers shaped our move. We adjusted by Peer learning.
Data helped; even a Excel-based trendline gave us clearer demand patterns during Christmas.
